attorneys: .Will Wilson, Attorney General of Texas, and Henry G. Braswell, Assistant Attorney General, for the State of Texas, plaintiff.

opinions.text: On a motion for leave to file a bill of complaint. The defendants are directed to file, on or before June 1st, a response, or responses, to the prayers for temporary injunctions contained in Paragraphs 3 and 4 of the motion for leave to file the bill of complaint.
